question: Knowing what is known at the review date, would we write materially different protections for this borrower?
updated_summary: Review of the current covenant package (C01-C05) against evidence through May 6 2025 shows no dated evidence requiring tightening, loosening, or addition of protections; all clauses remain appropriate.
updated_reasons: All clauses retained; weakened assumptions A03 (potential need for additional debt) and A04 (inventory misalignment) are already covered by the existing negative covenant on additional indebtedness and the Minimum Core Assets Test (which includes inventory), so no new protection is required.
reading: Changes listed as evidence-attributable appear only when the new reports are supplied. Changes also present in the control reflect pre-existing gaps or model drafting preference, not newly emerging drift. One run of each; repeat-run stability is not yet measured.
